method: Lexicographic inquiry priority using only source-checked evidence: (1) active appropriate license and San Francisco service evidence; (2) published combined plumbing/building scope; (3) adjacent technical case evidence; (4) occupied-property evidence; (5) existing owner estimate. Unknowns are not scored as zero or as success. This is an inquiry order, not a verified performance ranking or award recommendation.
